description: The built-in slide layouts of OPF 0.19: 30 region-list templates (opf-layout/v2) named by intent, in six groups (Openers and closers, Text, Groups of items, Numbers, Visuals, Mixed), in picker order. Each entry names the record's id, name, one-line summary and group; the full record (its direction and ordered list of regions) lives in the per-id JSON file alongside this index.

records.name: Cover
records.summary: The opening slide: title, subtitle and an optional picture.

records.name: Section
records.summary: A divider between parts: the section title and an optional subtitle.

records.name: Agenda
records.summary: What the talk covers: the parts, as one list that flows into columns when long.

records.name: Agenda beside
records.summary: A concise agenda beside its title and introduction.

records.name: Statement
records.summary: One message, large and alone.

records.name: Closing
records.summary: The last slide: thanks, the call to action and contact details.

records.name: Text
records.summary: Prose. Several blocks sit side by side when short and stack when long.

records.name: List
records.summary: Bulleted or numbered points; one long list flows into columns.

records.name: Quote
records.summary: One or more quotations with attribution and photo.

records.name: Two columns
records.summary: Two independent columns of any content.

records.name: Three columns
records.summary: Three independent columns of any content.

records.name: Pillars
records.summary: Related ideas arranged in equal columns.

records.name: Comparison
records.summary: Two options side by side (before and after, pros and cons, us and them), with an optional verdict.

records.name: Process
records.summary: Steps in order, in one row.

records.name: Timeline
records.summary: Dated events or a roadmap along one axis, with optional notes.

records.name: FAQ
records.summary: Questions with their answers.

records.name: Metrics
records.summary: One to six headline numbers, with an optional note.

records.name: Scorecard
records.summary: Headline measures with their targets and status.

records.name: Image
records.summary: One picture, shown whole, under an optional title.

records.name: Image beside
records.summary: A picture or video beside text.

records.name: Gallery
records.summary: One to six framed pictures: a screenshot, a diagram, a photo set.

records.name: Chart
records.summary: One to six charts, with an optional note.

records.name: Chart beside
records.summary: A chart with the takeaway beside it.

records.name: Table
records.summary: A table across the slide, with an optional note.

records.name: Table beside
records.summary: A table with commentary beside it.

records.name: Code
records.summary: Source code with the explanation beside it.

records.name: Hero
records.summary: A lead message with a picture and supporting points.

records.name: Dashboard
records.summary: Headline numbers over charts.

records.name: Team
records.summary: People: photo, name and role cards.

records.name: Logos
records.summary: Customer, partner or sponsor logos in a grid of up to 12.
